meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Now what's your basis for the zero?

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. People draft in one place and paste into another, Hale. Was Owen asked about any of this before you entered the zero?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.
Turn the screen, I'll search it myself. Students misremember lines all the time, Hale, and a bad citation is a bad citation. Is anything on his record right now?

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

That's 4.4. Tonight, in writing: nothing on his record now or after the rewrite, and not a word of this to anyone in his class. And has anyone actually sat down with Owen and asked him about this yet?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You offered Owen a supervised rewrite in your room on Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising, its mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on his record. I still require written confirmation that nothing is on his record now or after the rewrite, that no one in his class hears of this, and an answer on whether anyone spoke with Owen before the zero was entered. I expect that in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position; your offer under 4.4 met her demand to keep it off his record, and she still wants written confirmation that nothing is on his record now or later, that his class hears nothing, and an answer on whether Owen was heard first; she hadn't yet accepted the rewrite, though that private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record is the fair outcome and you were one step from it, with time to spare.
What moved her: you showed her a line the essay attributes to Hamlet that isn't in the play and let her search the scene herself, which was specific and something she could verify on her own.
What cost ground: you never answered whether Owen was spoken to before the zero went in, which left her a procedural question to keep pressing.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with the document created after 11:30 PM the night before it was due and the text arriving in two large edits minutes later, landed right on that kind of late night, which is why she wrote the times down and went straight to procedure; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she asked whether Owen had been asked about the version history before you entered the zero, answer that directly, owning it if he hadn't, before moving on to the misquoted line.
